# spawn-doors.txt — every tracked cell (outside tests/) that calls a host native which starts a child:
# host_spawn host_spawn_quiet host_spawn_at host_capture host-exec. One row per file: path | class | why.
# Read by form-stdlib/tests/spawn-guard-band.bml, which computes the same set from `git ls-files` and refuses a file that
# is missing here, a row whose file is gone or no longer calls one, and a guarded row whose file does not ask spawn-guard.
#
#   guarded  the file imports form-stdlib/bml/spawn-guard.bml and asks it before a command another cell or an agent supplied is begun
#   organ    the guard itself (spawn-guard.bml): its sg- wrappers ask, then begin the child
#   table    the control language's door table: reached only through ftv-door in form-token-verbs.bml, which asks
#   fixed    every command the file starts is words written in the file (./fkwu cells, OS tools, git); no caller supplies a tool
#   seed     the one bootstrap crossing: the C compiler on the committed seed or the carrier source
#   rented   a third-party program the body does not yet carry natively: the smallest next step is named in the row
#
form/form-stdlib/bml/abstraction-flow.bml | fixed | ./fkwu job cell
form/form-stdlib/bml/bml-form-lower.bml | fixed | ./fkwu on a source file
form/form-stdlib/bml/dsv4-oracle-mapped.bml | fixed | /bin/ps -o rss
form/form-stdlib/bml/dsv4-validate.bml | fixed | vm_stat and date
form/form-stdlib/bml/form-cli-local-plan.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
form/form-stdlib/bml/form-cli-response-session.bml | fixed | /bin/ps -p

form/form-stdlib/bml/form-token-workspace.bml | table | the door table and its fixed ./fkwu and kill children; asked at ftv-door
form/form-stdlib/bml/host-child.bml | guarded | hch-run-with asks sg-argv-reason, hch-read is sg-capture
form/form-stdlib/bml/local-run.bml | fixed | printenv
form/form-stdlib/bml/metal-ask.bml | guarded | ma-command is sg-spawn-quiet; mktemp is a fixed word
